selection.rule: Homepage events come from current RSS/advisory sources. CVEs are shown only when the source article/advisory mentions them.

items.title: Ryuk ransomware member sentenced to 24 months in prison
items.summary: An Armenian man was sentenced to 24 months in prison and 3 years of supervised release for hacking U.S. companies and encrypting their systems in Ryuk ransomware attacks. [...]

items.title: Check Point warns of hackers exploiting Security Gateway VPN RCE flaw
items.summary: Cybersecurity company Check Point has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-85102, a pre-authentication remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the VPN certificate-handling functionality of its Security Gateway product. [...]

items.title: InfraTrust report warns network management systems under attack
items.summary: Attackers are increasingly targeting the management systems used to control enterprise infrastructure, with several critical vulnerabilities actively exploited before or shortly after vendors disclosed them. [...]

items.title: Arista patches actively exploited VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day
items.summary: Arista Networks has released security patches for a zero-day flaw that is being actively exploited and affects VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) On-Prem deployments. [...]

items.title: Arista Urges Immediate Patching of Exploited VCO Zero-Day
items.summary: Remote attackers could trigger the critical-severity flaw to access privileged internal functionality. The post Arista Urges Immediate Patching of Exploited VCO Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Critical F5 BIG-IP Vulnerability Exploited as Zero-Day
items.summary: Unauthenticated attackers could send malicious traffic to BIG-IP to achieve remote code execution. The post Critical F5 BIG-IP Vulnerability Exploited as Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: F5 patches BIG-IP APM zero-day flaw exploited in RCE attacks
items.summary: F5 has released security updates to address a critical BIG-IP APM zero-day vulnerability being exploited in remote code execution attacks. [...]

items.title: ShinyHunters claims FBI hack, data theft in PeopleSoft zero-day breach
items.summary: The ShinyHunters extortion gang claims it breached FBI systems using a new Oracle PeopleSoft zero-day vulnerability, gaining access to internal services and stealing sensitive data on employees and job applicants. [...]
